messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 20):
"""
S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 6.2 Expected proportions of business to be procured by each channel shall be indicated for the next 5 years. Distribution Channel Year 1 Year 2 Year 3 Year 4 Year 5 1.Individual Agents 2. Corporate Agents 3. Insurance Brokers 4.Web Aggregators 5.Micro Insurance Agents 6.CSC 7.PoS 8.Direct - Only Online 9.Direct Marketing - Others (Incorporate separate line for each distribution channel) 10. Others- specify 11. Total Section VII - Reinsurance arrangements S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 7.1 Retention limit 7.2 Name of the reinsurer (s) 7.3 Terms of reinsurance(type of reinsurance, commissions, etc.). 7.4 Any recapture provisions shall be described. 7.5 Reinsurance rates provided 7.6 Whether a copy of the reinsurance program and a copy of the Treaty is submitted to the IRDAI.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
